text: “Who gave her away?” “Miss Vye.” “How very remarkable! It is to be considered an honour, I suppose?” “Who’s Miss Vye?” said Clym. “Captain Vye’s granddaughter, of Mistover Knap.” “A proud girl from Budmouth,” said Mrs. Yeobright. “One not much to my liking. People say she’s a witch, but of course that’s absurd.” The reddleman kept to himself his acquaintance with that fair personage, and also that Eustacia was there because he went to fetch her, in accordance with a promise he had given as soon as he learnt that the marriage was to take place.
